title: GCP Billing
description: Reads the standard usage-cost export in BigQuery (billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_010EF5_39FD45_37CA72), not Cloud Monitoring — export lags actual spend by up to a day, so this is for trend, not a live meter. Gross cost is what usage would cost without promotional credits; net cost is what actually lands on the bill. On a fresh/trial billing account, credits typically cover gross cost in full, so net sits near $0 — gross is the number that tracks growing usage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM `wine-library-mate.billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_010EF5_39FD45_37CA72`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_start_time)

SELECT
  SUM(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c), 0)) AS credits
FROM `wine-library-mate.billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_010EF5_39FD45_37CA72`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_start_time)

SELECT
  SUM(cost) + SUM(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c), 0)) AS cost
FROM `wine-library-mate.billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_010EF5_39FD45_37CA72`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_start_time)

panels.title: Daily gross cost by service
panels.description: Before credits — tracks usage growth even while credits keep the actual bill at $0.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(usage_start_time, '1d') AS time,
  service.description AS metric,
  SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM `wine-library-mate.billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_010EF5_39FD45_37CA72`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_start_time)
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cost by service
panels.description: Gross, credits and net side by side, so a $0 net doesn't hide which service is actually driving usage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  service.description AS Service,
  SUM(cost) AS `Gross cost`,
  SUM(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c), 0)) AS Credits,
  SUM(cost) + SUM(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c), 0)) AS `Net cost`
FROM `wine-library-mate.billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_010EF5_39FD45_37CA72`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_start_time)
GROUP BY Service
ORDER BY `Gross cost` DESC

panels.title: Gross cost by GKE namespace
panels.description: From cost_management_config's namespace labeling (terraform/gke.tf). Rows with a null namespace are cost that isn't a labeled GKE workload — other GCP services, cluster overhead, or unscheduled capacity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  labels.value AS Namespace,
  SUM(cost) AS Cost
FROM `wine-library-mate.billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_010EF5_39FD45_37CA72`
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(labels) AS labels ON labels.key = 'k8s-namespace'
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_start_time)
GROUP BY Namespace
ORDER BY Cost DESC

SELECT
  sku.description AS SKU,
  service.description AS Service,
  SUM(cost) AS Cost
FROM `wine-library-mate.billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_010EF5_39FD45_37CA72`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_start_time)
GROUP BY SKU, Service
ORDER BY Cost DESC
LIMIT 20
